CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_posti_disponibili_trigger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$DECLARE capacita integer; picco bigint;BEGIN  SELECT posti_totali INTO capacita FROM public.corse WHERE id=NEW.corsa_id FOR UPDATE;  IF capacita IS NULL OR capacita <= 0 OR NEW.posti_richiesti IS NULL OR NEW.posti_richiesti <= 0    OR NEW.start_offset IS NULL OR NEW.end_offset IS NULL    OR NEW.start_offset < 0 OR NEW.end_offset <= NEW.start_offset THEN    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Capacit… o indici prenotazione non validi';  END IF;  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.prenotazioni WHERE corsa_id=NEW.corsa_id    AND (start_offset IS NULL OR end_offset IS NULL      OR start_offset < 0 OR end_offset <= start_offset OR posti_richiesti <= 0)) THEN    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Prenotazioni storiche con segmenti non validi';  END IF;  WITH tratte AS (    SELECT start_offset AS s,end_offset AS e,posti_richiesti AS p    FROM public.prenotazioni WHERE corsa_id=NEW.corsa_id    UNION ALL SELECT NEW.start_offset,NEW.end_offset,NEW.posti_richiesti  ), eventi AS (    SELECT s AS punto,p AS delta FROM tratte    UNION ALL SELECT e,-p FROM tratte  ), delta AS (SELECT punto,SUM(delta) AS valore FROM eventi GROUP BY punto),  occupazione AS (SELECT SUM(valore) OVER (ORDER BY punto) AS posti FROM delta)  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(posti),0) INTO picco FROM occupazione;  IF picco > capacita THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Capacit… insufficiente: %/%',picco,capacita; END IF;  RETURN NEW;END;$function$
